title: Tiki Drifters
specs: Hand-built floating tiki bar with thatched roof and bamboo bar
Only passengers 21 and over can drink alcohol onboard; IDs checked before departing
Children 13 and under must wear a life jacket at all times per state law
Maximum 6 passengers plus Captain and crew
blurb: Guests board a hand-built floating tiki bar with a thatched roof, bamboo bar, bar-stool seating, and a real onboard bathroom. They bring their own drinks and cruise the Erie Canal for a couple of hours with a captain handling the boat. The experience is private for the party and includes a Bluetooth speaker for music.
